title: ArgentinaCS
description: The biggest CS community in Argentina is now in Minecraft with protected land, proximity voice chat, and skills that level up as you play — plus quirky extras like TreeTwerk. Every new player starts with 3 days of free VIP
body:
**The biggest CS community in Argentina is now in Minecraft.**
*A Counter-Strike community (ArgentinaCS) — now also on Minecraft. Heads up: the community and staff are primarily Spanish-speaking (Argentina).*

## What is ArgentinaCS Minecraft?

A **Survival** server open to the whole community. No Premium account required — offline (cracked) accounts are supported via password registration — and you can also join from **Bedrock Edition** thanks to cross-play support.

## 🧭 Features

- **Land protection**: place a Protection Stone and no one else can break, build, or loot your chests. Sizes from 8 to 256 blocks, earned by playing.
- **Skills that level up on their own**: mining, farming, fishing, combat and more level up automatically as you play, with real in-game bonuses.
- **Death graves**: your items aren't lost on death — they're saved in a grave you can recover with `/graves`.
- **Homes, warps, and teleporting**: `/sethome`, `/warp`, `/tpa` and friends, like any serious survival server.
- **Playtime rewards**: `/playtime` gives you claimable rewards just for logging hours.
- **Proximity voice chat**: hear nearby players by installing the free Simple Voice Chat mod (optional — without it you play normally, just without voice).
- **Multi-version support**: join with almost any Minecraft Java version thanks to extended compatibility.

## 🕺 TreeTwerk

Our own custom mechanic: crouch repeatedly next to a crop or a tree sapling and it grows faster. No commands, no fuss — just twerk near it.

## 🎁 Start with an edge

- New players automatically get **3 days of free VIP** on first join, so you can try every perk.
- Invite friends with your `/referral` code: once your referral hits 1 hour of playtime, you get 5 days of VIP + a free Protection Stone (up to 5 referrals).

## ⭐ VIP rank (optional)

Purchased via `/vip`, lasts 30 days, and is paid through MercadoPago (QR code), with automatic, instant in-game delivery. It's not required to play — it's a supporter rank with quality-of-life perks:

| Benefit | Regular player | VIP |
|---|:-:|:-:|
| Protection stones | 2 | 7 |
| Homes (`/sethome`) | 3 | 5 |
| `/back` (return after death/teleport) | ❌ | ✅ |
| Night vision (`/nv`) | ❌ | ✅ |
| VeinMiner (mine a whole ore/tree vein at once) | ❌ | ✅ |
| Silk Spawner (move spawners) | ❌ | ✅ |
| Elytra Fusion (fly while wearing armor) | ❌ | ✅ |
| Skill XP | normal | +5% |

Every VIP purchase also comes with a free 32-size Protection Stone.

## 🛡 Serious moderation

Active anti-cheat and an appealable punishment system, plus staff available in-game via `/helpop`. We play clean here.

## 📋 Server info

- **Version:** Java 1.21.x (Paper) — compatible with Bedrock and other versions
- **Java IP:** `45.235.98.41:25565`
- **Bedrock IP:** `45.235.98.41:19132`
- **Discord:** https://discord.gg/9Z3vPxWzEs

Questions? Use `/help` in-game or ping staff with `/helpop`.
